newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil ends mostly up after late covering.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil ends mostly up after late covering.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL

PALM OIL FUTURES - Prices ended mostly higher after late weekend covering and a techical rebound. Sentiment was weak for most of the day but turned steady near the close. Trading was moderate with June falling to 1,232 low. Next week resistance at 1,260 and support at 1,200. Market direction also depends on Chicago soyoil tonight.
PALM PHYSICAL - Also aided by futures, interest in products.
"There was hardly a clear trend," the trader said.
A squeeze of sellers in spot futures also influenced the other futures positions, traders said.

"There was follow-through selling from yesterday and with falls in soyoil, prices were marked down in morning trade," a trader said. Lack of fresh tenders, after Egypt's offtake on Wednesday, also limited price movements, traders said.

Technically, the market is expected to be rangebound as players are still concerned about the production outlook in coming months. RR SHK GRO SI MF IJC IF RR MY OILS EMG DRV #USNKLR058509 FIX OVME MORE M :KL palm oil ends mostly up after late covering =3
Traders said output is likely to increase in the short-term because of high yield harvesting period.
Turnover on the futures market was 1,714 lots.
Physicals April (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,290 ringgit against bids of 1,287.50, after trading from 1,282.50 to 1,287.50. April (central) saw offers at 1,280 and bids at 1,272.50.
May (south) was offered at 1,285 and bids at 1,277.50 with earlier trades at 1,275 and 1,270. May (central) was offered at 1,275 against 1,262.50.
Among refined products, Apr RBD palm oil was offered at $545 a tonne FOB Malaysia, May $542.50, June at $540 and July/Aug/Sep at $535. May was traded at $535.
Apr RBD palm olein saw offers at $580, May at $577.50, Jun at $572.50 and July/Aug/Sep at $567.50. April was traded at $575, and May at $572.50 and $575.
Apr RBD palm stearin was offered at $440 and Apr/May palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $290.
